findings.title: Logo measurable opt-in deleted
findings.detail: Replaced the Logo component (with opt-in measurable / markMeasure: 'mark') with createLogo({ href, ariaLabel, defaultHeight }) and dropped the documented single-instance rule. Prior comment stated header, footer, and drawer all render Logo and marking every instance made [data-measure="mark"] resolve to three elements and hung the harness. This diff neither passes measurable into createLogo nor proves createLogo defaults to exactly one mark. Cannot verify brand-mark QA still works; treat as fail until createLogo and call sites are inspected.

findings.title: Header QA markers removed unproven
findings.detail: Explicit testId="compact-header" and measure="header" were removed from SharedHeader. A comment claims qa-visual markers default on the shared Header, but SharedHeader is not in this diff, so defaults are unverified. If defaults differ (or are off), compact-header / data-measure="header" harnesses break. FAIL until shared Header defaults are confirmed.

findings.title: Exported NavLink removed without callers
findings.detail: Public NavLink wrapper and NavLinkProps were deleted; drawerNavItems now only returns withGithubNav(...). No other file in this diff updates imports of NavLink from NavLinks. If any consumer still imports { NavLink }, the tree fails typecheck. Behavior of withGithubNav vs the prior inline github item is also not shown. Cannot verify compile or drawer IA equivalence from this diff alone.

findings.title: PageHeaderProps / PageDrawerProps unverified
findings.detail: Local HeaderProps and MobileDrawerProps were replaced by PageHeaderProps and PageDrawerProps from design-system/Page. Shape compatibility (menuOpen vs open, ref types, onToggleMenu vs onClose) is assumed, not shown. FAIL verification of type/API contract from this diff only.

findings.title: companyLegalColumns structure unverified
findings.detail: Company and Legal columns were inlined with fixed routes (/about, /contact, /terms, /privacy); now spread via companyLegalColumns({...labels}). Helper implementation is outside the diff, so hrefs, headings, and column order cannot be verified equal. If the helper uses different paths or omits a link, required legal/footer links regress.

findings.title: DRAWER_LOGO_HEIGHT only constant extract
findings.detail: DRAWER_LOGO_HEIGHT = 48 matches the previous hardcoded height={48} in MobileDrawer. Value preservation for that site is verifiable from the diff and is fine; not a defect.
